title: RFC-007: Move ledger-db from MySQL to Postgres
author: tomasz
text: Context: PLAT-88 showed MySQL row-lock deadlocks on ledger_entries during month-end. Usage-Based Pricing will need per-event ledger writes, roughly 40x today's write volume, with serializable transactions. Proposal: migrate ledger-db to Postgres under Project Atlas using dual-write, backfill, checksum verification, then cutover. Decision (approved by Arjun Mehta, 2026-02-02): migrate ledger-db to Postgres. Cutover target: end of Q2 2026.

title: Refund Policy
author: jordan
text: Customers can request a full refund within 30 days of any charge, no questions asked. Approved by Maya Chen. Refunds are issued through refund-engine.

title: Engineering Handbook: Release Process
author: omar
text: After PLAT-102: No production deploys on Fridays. Deploy window is Monday to Thursday, 10:00-16:00. All deploys go through deploy-pipeline. Rollbacks are manual and require the on-call engineer.

title: Support Playbook: Handling Refund Requests
author: mei
text: When a customer asks for a refund: 1) confirm the charge is within 30 days, 2) issue a full refund in refund-engine, 3) tag the ticket 'refund'. No approval needed within the 30-day window.

title: Help Center: Can I get a refund?
author: mei
text: Yes! You can get a full refund within 30 days of any charge, no questions asked. Contact support to start a refund.

title: Data Retention Policy
author: nina
text: All customer data, including invoices, is deleted 90 days after account cancellation. The deletion job runs nightly in analytics-warehouse. Approved by Maya Chen.

title: Platform On-call Rotation
author: hana
text: Weekly on-call rotation for Platform: Hana Kim, Ravi Iyer, Tomasz Novak, Omar Haddad. Escalation goes to Omar Haddad. ledger-db pages go to Tomasz Novak because he is the ledger expert.

title: Atlas Cutover Runbook (draft)
author: tomasz
text: Cutover date: Oct 28. Steps: 1) freeze writes 5 min, 2) final backfill, 3) run checksum verifier against MySQL and Postgres ledger-db, 4) flip billing-service to Postgres, 5) keep dual-write for 2 weeks for rollback. Note: only Tomasz currently has the prod credentials and context to run the checksum verifier. TODO: share with a second person.
